official_institution_checks.evidence: GINGER appeared in the Nov 6 cs.IR bulletin. The fixed arXiv author block lists Google Research on all ten authors. The paper covers query-time search and compression, distinct from the PiPNN II build paper. Its linked official repository is a placeholder at the checked revision; a repository link does not prove source code was released.
GSLM2 appeared as a November 4 directory entry. The fixed arXiv v1 is October 31 UTC, with November 3 announcements; the directory timestamp is not the first-publication date.

official_repository_search.limitation: Only repository creation is checked; public release of an older repository, updates to code, and new papers without new repositories are not counted.

screened_non_admissions.title: CAP-Mix: Item Representations Matter
screened_non_admissions.evidence: Meta work; v1 Sections 4.1–4.4 and Appendix G evaluate public interaction datasets, offline HR/NDCG and inference throughput. No production A/B or explicit full-traffic validation found. Not rerouted into another domain to bypass admission.
